name: wiggle-that-diagram
description: Turn a static "how it works" diagram into a short, captioned, looping explainer animation that sits inside an HTML slide deck or report, in three styles to pick from: a clean diagram clip, a hand-drawn whiteboard, and live SVG with a virtual camera. Paced so people can actually read it, with a step rail, Play/Pause, reduced motion, a deck switcher that fits the animation and its caption on one laptop screen, and checks that can fail. Built on huashu-art-motion.
